For hotels, homestays & local operators

Bharat Yatra for Business

List your property or service on the same platform travellers use to plan trips to 50+ destinations across India — including places the big booking sites rarely surface.

Roadmap note

This screen is a design mockup, not a live registration flow. In production, this is where hotels, homestays, restaurants and local tour/transport operators — especially in the Tier-2/3 destinations this app is built to promote — would register, get verified, and appear directly in traveller search results and the cost estimates shown in the app.

Trust & tools

Safer, clearer trips

Permits, verified-operator rules, stay checks, refunds and privacy in one place. Prototype: the checks below are demos, not live verification.

Permit checker

Compiled 4 Nov 2026 from public reports, not an official source. Rules change by state: always confirm on the state’s official portal.

What “Verified” means here

India has no single adventure-safety regulator, so we set our own bar. An operator must meet all five required checks.

Self-declaration demo. In production our team checks each document and records the date inspected.

Homestay & stay checklist

Rules are set by each state, so we collect the registration, not just a listing.

Demo only: nothing is sent or stored on a server.

Refunds and complaints
